chapters.reason: The paper introduces Plaid, a diffusion language model that operates on continuous token embeddings with Gaussian noise corruption and denoising, aligning with the description of embedding-based diffusion models.

While the paper focuses on embedding-based diffusion, it discusses algorithmic improvements for diffusion language models, which may relate to masked diffusion techniques, though not as the primary approach.
The paper compares diffusion models to autoregressive models like GPT-2, but does not explicitly integrate both paradigms; thus, hybrid AR-diffusion models are only marginally relevant.
